Top Heroes × DreamWorks How to Train Your Dragon
Facebook Comment Event! 🐉🔥 

⏰Collaboration Countdown: 1 Day to Go! 
The Pyromancer transforms into the Hookfang, and
the Adjudicator becomes the Stormfly—exclusive
collaboration skins are coming soon! 

💭 Skin Wishlist Event is Here! 
- Pyromancer: Hookfang Skin, Starting October 26,
log in daily and accumulate enough sign-in days to
claim this skin for FREE! 
- Adjudicator: Stormfly Skin, Join this comment event
for a chance to win it for FREE! 

📅Event Duration
October 11th – December 6th 2026 

🎁 Comment Milestone Rewards 
- 500 Comments: Unlock a server-wide reward:
[Collaboration Chat Frame]! 
 ✨ Plus, 5 lucky lords will be randomly selected
from the comments to receive the Adjudicator:
Stormfly skin! 
- Every additional 250 comment: Unlock an extra
server-wide reward! 
 ✨ Additionally, 1 more lucky lord will be selected to
win the Adjudicator: Stormfly skin! 

📝 How to Participate 
1. Each lord can only leave 1 valid comment.
Duplicate comments, spam, meaningless content, or
copy-paste replies will not count towards the event. 
2. Skin wish rewards are subject to in-game
availability and final review by the Top Heroes team. 

⚠️ Event Notes 
This event is a Top Heroes community interaction
event designed to encourage communication among
lords.
